scoring_justification: Kcl/Kmax is recomputed from agent-submitted h and theta, then compared against hidden experimental gold; h and theta are validated against an independent reference recomputation. T1 is feasible and provides stronger anti-bypass than trusting a self-reported scalar.

hidden_assets.purpose: Experimental Kcl/Kmax closure ratios from Table 2 of the source paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2 (Ravichandran method applied to threshold data).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct copy of the published values for the four martensite volume fractions.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are exactly as reported in the paper; they serve as the external comparison target for the theoretical model.

outputs.description: The agent's computed theoretical crack closure ratio and associated roughness factors for the four volume fractions of martensite. The hidden checker compares Kcl_Kmax to the paper's experimentally derived closure ratios and verifies monotonic increasing with Vm.

steps.description: Recompute Kcl/Kmax from raw h and theta; verify h and theta against independently computed reference (10% relative tolerance); compare Kcl/Kmax to paper experimental gold (absolute tolerance 0.1); check monotonic increase with Vm.
